goal: Build a self-contained, offline SplitFair Mini App for splitting a bill. Use only local assets; do not request fonts, scripts, APIs, or other resources from external hosts. Enter a dollar amount and number of people, calculate whole-cent shares that reconcile exactly to the total, show each person's share, validate invalid input, and make Reset clear the results. Keep allocateShares in split.mjs and add visible tests. Browser interaction uses labeled amount/people fields, a submit button, and a reset button; the results section exposes the rendered per-person amounts.

attempts.finalOutput: Implemented the SplitFair app in the supplied workspace. The earlier focused test run passed all 6 tests, including the acceptance tests and app-owned share allocation tests. Browser UAT has not been run; that tool is not available in my current tool list.

plan.task_instruction: Build a self-contained, offline SplitFair Mini App for splitting a bill. Use only local assets and make no requests to external hosts. Keep allocateShares in split.mjs. Provide labeled dollar-amount and people-count inputs, a submit button that calculates whole-cent per-person shares reconciling exactly to the total, visible validation for invalid input, a reset button that clears results, and a results section showing each person's amount. acceptance: The app works without network access or external fonts, scripts, APIs, or other resources.
allocateShares is defined in split.mjs and returns whole-cent shares whose sum equals the entered total.
Users can submit valid amount and people inputs and see each person's share in the results section.
Invalid input produces visible validation feedback.
Visible tests cover the share allocation behavior.
